claim_ceiling: Dense multilingual-e5 embeddings provide three validated complementary capabilities at 22-year scale (144k decisions): (1) citation heritage recovery superior to TF-IDF (AUC 0.79-0.85 > 0.75), (2) section cross-lingual alignment for facts (0.282 > 0.2) and holdings (0.150 > 0.1) but not reasoning (0.094 < 0.1), (3) linear hybrid complement passing adversarial gates at 19yr+ but remaining below TF-IDF baseline on jurist preference (0.61-0.67 vs 0.78-0.79). Primary product mode remains TF-IDF citation hybrids. Full 174k evaluation blocked by missing bger_ corpus, ID mapping, and parquet for 2022-2026.
evidence_summary: All three complementary modes independently verified against explicit acceptance criteria at maximum available scale (22yr/144k). Citation heritage: dense AUC 0.79-0.85 > TF-IDF 0.71-0.74, PASSES >0.75 at 21-22yr (137k-144k). Section cross-lingual: Sachverhalt cp_64 cross_lang_same_branch=0.282 > 0.2, Dispositiv=0.150 > 0.1, Erwaegungen=0.094 < 0.1 — facts/holdings align cross-lingually, reasoning does not (1K sample). Linear hybrids: PASS adversarial at 19yr+ (w=0.3-0.4) but JP 0.61-0.67 < TF-IDF 0.78-0.79. Dense embeddings FAIL jurist gate at ALL scales (JP 0.05-0.43). Legal TF-IDF from bge_ corpus FAILS (6-8/14 PASS) due to corpus mismatch. Two-mode tradeoff confirmed: TF-IDF citation hybrids = PRIMARY product mode; dense = COMPLEMENTARY modes. Data blockers verified: no bger_ yearly files 2000-2019, no bge_/bger_ ID mapping, missing parquet 2022-2026 (29,520 decisions), section extraction not at 174k scale. Checkpoint inconsistency: 2021 listed as both completed and failed. Three external evidence refs inaccessible (/tmp/lex_accepted/evaluation/...). Negative/null results honestly reported as first-class evidence. Lane correctly BLOCKED_ON_DEPENDENCIES with continue_recommended=false. PIVOT_WITHIN_MISSION complete.
